title: Quantum AI Studio Cyberpunk Landing Page
overview: Develop a high-impact, cyberpunk-themed landing page for the Quantum AI Studio SaaS product. The page must integrate advanced visual effects including a particle canvas, glassmorphism UI elements, and neon aesthetics to establish a futuristic brand identity while maintaining clear conversion paths for potential customers.

userStories.want: experience a visually immersive and high-tech landing page
userStories.soThat: they immediately perceive the advanced nature of the Quantum AI technology.

userStories.want: view a clear feature showcase and interactive pricing toggle
userStories.soThat: they can quickly understand the product's value proposition and cost structure.
to drive higher conversion rates and highlight key growth metrics.

functionalRequirements: Implement an interactive particle canvas background in apps/nexus-studio/index.html.
Apply glassmorphism effects to all content cards and UI containers.
Develop an animated statistics section with counter-up animations.
Create a feature showcase section with interactive hover states.
Implement a functional pricing toggle to switch between Monthly and Yearly billing.
Apply neon glow effects to all primary call-to-action (CTA) buttons.
nonFunctionalRequirements: The particle canvas must maintain 60fps performance on standard hardware.
The design must be fully responsive across mobile, tablet, and desktop devices.
Neon elements must maintain sufficient contrast ratios for accessibility (WCAG 2.1).
Asset loading for high-resolution visual effects must be optimized for fast initial page load.
acceptanceCriteria: Particle canvas responds dynamically to mouse movements and window resizing.
Pricing toggle updates the displayed price values instantly without page reload.
Glassmorphism effect is visible and consistent across all UI components.
Neon buttons exhibit a distinct glow effect on hover and active states.
All interactive elements are accessible via keyboard navigation.
